topics.title: Yeoman’s Labor, Navy Ranks and Birthday Parties
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss the word ‘yeoman,’ its naval origins and laborious service, alongside anecdotes about a man running around with multiple women and his wife's cute appearance at a commercial. They also delve into elaborate birthday parties featuring magicians and live animals while wives complain about their tiresome events.

topics.title: Window Sales and Bruce Springsteen Jokes
topics.summary: Jan and Craig promote their window factory, highlighting workmanship and prices while discussing an aborted attempt to block Oprah Winfrey’s view at Shea Stadium. They then engage in a series of jokes about Bruce Springsteen, including one referencing Christa McAuliffe and another involving mercury in tuna fish, concluding with Dave Marshall's objectivity.

topics.title: Gotti Investigation, Diner Dreams & Truck Troubles
topics.summary: During the broadcast, investigators discuss evidence related to the murder of Gotti and linked store ownership. Calls about concert tickets and Howard’s thoughts on mob figures are interspersed with a lengthy segment exploring the Beanstalk restaurant chain and potential mishaps involving stranded trucks under overpasses.

topics.title: Frustrated Attempts to Contact Bono
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts repeatedly attempt to contact musician Bono via phone calls, expressing frustration with unsuccessful attempts and sharing anecdotes about past experiences trying to secure interviews or appearances from celebrities. They discuss various locations including Fort Lee, Rockefeller Center, and Woodbury Common.

topics.title: Garden State Brick Face Sales Call
topics.summary: A sales representative pitches Garden State Brick Face’s expertise installing brick and stucco on older homes, emphasizing customer satisfaction with beautiful results. The speaker offers free design consultations and affordable pricing while urging listeners to call for an appointment, referencing a potential connection between the company and Gary Hart's home renovation project.

topics.title: Gaudy Jr.'s Trial Delays and Kate Smith's Mausoleum
topics.summary: John Gaudy Jr.’s assault trial is repeatedly delayed due to his father’s legal issues, with witnesses experiencing ‘gaudy syndrome,’ raising concerns about a fair jury. Simultaneously, efforts to build a complex mausoleum for deceased singer Kate Smith in Alaska face significant obstacles including frozen ground and church regulations.
